title: Review console engine: one interface for every panel
why: New panels are adapters over console.open(), never new viewers
summary: console.lua owns windows, keymaps, state, kill/refresh, legend, focus-return, and which-key registration; 9 panels are thin adapters (list/rows/preview/actions/keys/identity). ~2000 lines of duplicated viewer scaffolding collapsed into one module.

title: Stale edit_range proposals corrupt files when applied late
why: Stale coordinates corrupt files — recover with full replace
summary: An edit_range emitted against an old file state lands at wrong coordinates after later edits shift lines — duplicated blocks, mangled functions. Recovery: atomic full-file replace, then re-lint.

title: Same-file proposals in one group: older edits silently superseded
why: Multi-edit groups skip older edits — use separate groups
summary: Revision ordering applies only the newest row per group+path; older edits to the same file become [superseded] and da refuses them. Same-file edits must go in separate groups — cost real debugging time.
